src/legacy/index.ts.name: Legacy entry
src/legacy/index.ts.description: Gathers the older policy model's functions for hosts still migrating to scoped approvals.

src/legacy/types.ts.name: Legacy policy shapes
src/legacy/types.ts.description: Defines the older model's observations, decisions, per-napplet rules, content matchers and settings.

src/legacy/defaults.ts.name: Legacy default limits
src/legacy/defaults.ts.description: Sets the older model's built-in limits: flag on excess, block startup floods, and a quarter budget out of focus.

src/legacy/config.ts.name: Legacy settings changes
src/legacy/config.ts.description: Changes per-napplet stance, limits and content matchers by returning new settings, and saves or safely reloads them as text.

src/legacy/evaluate.ts.name: Legacy check
src/legacy/evaluate.ts.description: Applies the older per-napplet rules and content matchers, then hands counting to the current budget check.

src/legacy/state.ts.name: Legacy settings holder
src/legacy/state.ts.description: Keeps the older model's settings and counts together, saving settings through a host-supplied hook while counts reset on reload.
